question: List all students
reference_sql: SELECT id, name, year, city FROM students

question: Show the grade distribution
reference_sql: SELECT grade, COUNT(*) FROM grades GROUP BY grade

question: How many students are in each city?
reference_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM students GROUP BY city

question: What is the average score by city?
reference_sql: SELECT s.city, ROUND(AVG(g.score),1) FROM students s JOIN grades g ON s.id=g.student_id GROUP BY s.city

question: What is the average score by department?
reference_sql: SELECT sub.department, ROUND(AVG(g.score),1) FROM grades g JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id=g.subject_id GROUP BY sub.department

question: Which students scored above 90?
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM students s JOIN grades g ON s.id=g.student_id WHERE g.score>90

question: List students in the science department
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM students s JOIN grades g ON s.id=g.student_id JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id=g.subject_id WHERE sub.department='Science'

question: What is the top score in each subject?
reference_sql: SELECT sub.subject_name, MAX(g.score) FROM grades g JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id=g.subject_id GROUP BY sub.subject_name

question: Top 3 cities by average score, highest first
reference_sql: SELECT s.city, ROUND(AVG(g.score),1) AS avg_score FROM students s JOIN grades g ON s.id=g.student_id GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average score by hometown?
reference_sql: SELECT s.city, AVG(g.score) FROM students s JOIN grades g ON s.id=g.student_id GROUP BY s.city
